subject: gse/navier-stokes
body: CORRECTION to the BKM convergence sweep. The delivered report claimed 0.9834 was NOT reproducible. A pole-row sweep (4 pole treatments x 2 operators) falsifies that: no pole row rescues the VECTOR operator (all positive, 574->12510->4.4e6 as Nr 32/64/256), so the instability is the discretized -u_theta/r^2 term itself, not the pole row; but with that term removed the pole row IS decisive (identical interiors, 138741.8 vs 514.8 depending only on row 0), and that scheme gives a MONOTONE 0.976084 at Nr=32 rising to 0.982902 at Nr=64 -- within 0.05% of the audit's 0.9834. A Cartesian grid has no singular axis node, so it never manufactures the term that breaks the cylindrical vector collocation; 0.9834 is the answer of an operator structurally like the scalar variant. Report amended, 3 attribution tests added (physics suite 14/14), audit doc updated.
